description:
fz-go4.17.11 ("make northstar and agent docs match the corrected model") and fz-go4.16.12 ("archive pull-based plan artifact") were closed, but the audit found stale/false doc claims that contradict the code.

FIXES
- README.md:493 lists dump kinds "materialized" and "abi" that DO NOT EXIST. dump.rs (DumpKind enum + parse_dump_kind, ~lines 17-23 / 247-254) supports only activations, types, backend, native, fnir, clif -- the code's own error string enumerates exactly those. Drop materialized and abi from the doc.
- pipeline.md:79-81 states "The temporary planning artifact ../pull-based.html has been retired" but the file still physically exists (../pull-based.html, ~81 KB). Either actually archive/delete it (fz-go4.16.12 was closed claiming this) or correct the doc to point at where it lives.
- semantic-fixpoint.md:22-23 carries a stale forward-reference: "the result side is a none() sentinel today and becomes the addressed result r0 in fz-hwn.27.6." The code already mints r0 (identity.rs:98-104 via types.result_alpha(); doc-comment at 77-82 already says r0, NOT none()). fz-hwn.27.6 landed; delete the none()-today claim.

SIGNAL
Every dump kind / artifact / result-slot claim in the docs is backed by current code. rg for "materialized" and "abi" dump kinds in README finds nothing.
title: Fix stale pull-path docs: README dump kinds, retired pull-based.html claim, semantic-fixpoint none() ref
